study: Allen et al. 2015 — My Teaching Partner-Secondary (MTP-S) web-mediated coaching, teacher-level RCT, secondary mixed subjects
delivery_evidence: Genuine mix: an initial in-person 3-hour workshop (master-teacher-led) before the school year and a later booster workshop, combined with the core remote component — teachers upload class video to a coach who posts segments/comments on a private Web site, then hold a phone-conference planning cycle (~5-6 cycles/yr) (MTP-S Coaching Intervention section, p.~478-479).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome is the Virginia Standards of Learning (SOL) end-of-course state standardized achievement test, pooled across focal courses — a broad independent state assessment not tailored to the intervention (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; Table 2).
curriculum_evidence: MTP-S is explicitly content-independent: it does not target instruction/knowledge in a specific content area or curriculum but coaches the quality of teacher-student interactions (CLASS-S framework) applied across subjects; no new curriculum/materials provided (p.~476-477).
outcome_timing_evidence: Student SOL achievement measured at the end of Year 2 of the 2-year intervention, on teachers' current-year focal class (extraction timepoint=post, end of Year 2); no delayed post-intervention follow-up.
